capacity_argument: Each finite term magnitude is below 2^2098 units of2^-1074; at most2^60 such terms have magnitude below2^2158.70 base2^32 digits retain signed headroom. Normalize every2^30 nonzero finite additions keeps carry-save digit additions withinLong bounds; merges normalize their destination and cannot exceed the declared count.

capacity_contract.merge: Counts add, including self-merge doubling; cancellation never reduces counts.
capacity_contract.refusal: Either[ExactSumError,Unit]; CapacityExceeded is admitted before mutation; source and target remain unchanged.
capacity_contract.scope: Finite-input nearest-even bit identity; canonical exact zero +0.0. NaN payload bits/order unspecified. Builders mutable and not thread-safe. value clones its finite digit buffer; copy owns independent storage.
capacity_contract.success: Cached Right(()) avoids per-call success result objects; no unchecked Unit facade.
capacity_contract.zero_nonfinite: Do not consume finite-input capacity; original separate IEEE channel is preserved.
